A south coast day in 3 stops 🗺️

1. Black River: Cruise the river, spot the mangroves and slow down.
2. YS Falls: Swim in cool pools below tiered falls and play on the rope swings.
3. Pelican Bar: Sit in a little bar built on stilts in the sea.

Pick up at MBJ and head south. Allow about 2 hours.

A Kingston day in 3 stops 🗺️

1. Hellshire: Fried fish, bammy and a beach close to the city.
2. Blue Mountains: Wind up through cool, misty hills to coffee farms and big views over Kingston.
3. National Gallery: See Jamaican art, from classic to contemporary, on the Kingston waterfront.

Pick up at Norman Manley or our Kingston offices.
